summary: community.dns now depends on community.library_inventory_filtering_v1 for inventory host filtering. The Ansible package and ansible-galaxy installs handle it automatically, but manual copies or git clones must install it too.
questions: Why do community.dns inventory plugins fail after cloning the repo?
Do I need to install extra collections for community.dns inventory?

answer_card.title: community.dns inventory filtering dependency
answer_card.answer_md: community.dns inventory plugins now need `community.library_inventory_filtering_v1`. The Ansible package and `ansible-galaxy collection install` include it automatically. If you install by copying files or cloning git, install the dependency yourself.
